idea-plugin.name: Clocked In
idea-plugin.description:
Track your working hours with one clock that you and your AI agents share. Start, pause and stop it yourself from the IDE, or let an agent such as Claude Code do it while it works on your requests.

Features

  • Toolbar clock: sits next to the run controls and shows the time worked in the current session, with the same play, pause and stop icons as the buttons.
  • Start, Pause and Stop buttons next to the clock. Pause is a break inside the session and Resume carries on with it; Stop ends the session and resets the clock.
  • ⋮ menu: This Week (today's and this week's totals), Print Timesheet, Export Unpaid Timesheet (an Excel timesheet to hand in, with weekly totals and hours per day), the tool window, Add Session, and Install Agent Skill.
  • Clocked In tool window: today's and this week's totals, split into time you started and time agents started. Show sessions for any date range or all dates, and add, edit and delete them.
  • Paid tracking: tick sessions as paid, filter to unpaid or paid sessions, tick several rows to mark them paid, unpaid or delete them, and see what's still unpaid.
  • Agent tools: clock_in, clock_pause, clock_out, clock_status and clock_report on the IDE's built-in MCP server.
  • You stay in control: every agent start, pause or stop shows a notification with Undo. Agents can't pause or stop a session you started, and they can't end a break you took.
  • Agent skill: run /clocked-in in an agent session. The agent starts or resumes the clock for each request and pauses it when it's done. It only clocks you out when you ask.

Getting started

  1. Use ▶ Start, ⏸ Pause and ■ Stop next to the toolbar clock, Tools | Clocked In, or Ctrl+Alt+Shift+K (pause, or start and resume).
  2. To let agents use the clock, enable the MCP server in Settings | Tools | MCP Server and connect your agent there.
  3. Choose ⋮ → Install Agent Skill…. Pick All Projects or This Project for Claude Code, or copy the skill for another agent.
  4. In an agent session, run /clocked-in. Run /clocked-in off to stop tracking, or /clocked-in stop to clock out.

Good to know

  • There's no idle detection: the clock runs until you or an agent pauses or stops it. Closing the IDE clocks you out.
  • The IDE's MCP server needs an open project for tool calls. If your agent works in a folder that isn't open in the IDE, the skill tells it to pass any open project; the clock is the same for all of them.
  • Each IDE (for example IntelliJ IDEA and Rider) keeps its own clock.

Privacy

Your sessions are stored only on your computer, in the IDE's configuration folder. The plugin sends nothing over the network.
